item.question: One arrangement has 5 rows of 2 squares and 3 extra squares. Another has 2 rows, each with 5 yellow and 3 blue squares. Write an expression for each and find the number of squares.
steps_tex: First arrangement: $5 \times 2 + 3 = 10 + 3 = 13$.
Second arrangement: each row has $5 + 3$ squares and there are $2$ rows, so $2 \times (5 + 3) = 2 \times 8 = 16$.
The second can also be counted as $5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16$ or $5 \times 2 + 3 \times 2 = 10 + 6 = 16$.

item.question: Consider 500 − (250 − 100). Can we write it as 500 − 250 − 100? Find the right way to remove the bracket.
steps_tex: Working out the bracket first: $250 - 100 = 150$, and $500 - 150 = 350$.
